```{python}
#| label: fig-netlist-scale-schematic
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The native device and the external wrapper share d, g, s and b. Each native MOS receives the global scale once; the wrapper arguments retain their interface values."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
import schemdraw.flow as flow
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2, fontsize=14)
    m = d.add(elm.NFet(bulk=True).at((0, 0)).reverse())
    d.add(elm.Line().at(m.drain).up().length(0.8).dot().label('d', loc='top'))
    d.add(elm.Line().at(m.source).down().length(0.8).dot().label('s', loc='bottom'))
    d.add(elm.Line().at(m.gate).left().length(0.7).dot().label('g', loc='left'))
    d.add(elm.Line().at(m.bulk).right().length(0.8).dot().label('b', loc='right'))
    d.add(elm.Label().at((0, -3.2)).label('Mnative'))
    block = d.add(flow.Box(w=2.5, h=1.5).at((4.6, -0.75)).anchor('center').label('external'))
    d.add(elm.Line().at(block.N).up().length(0.8).dot().label('d', loc='top'))
    d.add(elm.Line().at(block.S).down().length(0.8).dot().label('s', loc='bottom'))
    d.add(elm.Line().at(block.W).left().length(0.6).dot().label('g', loc='left'))
    d.add(elm.Line().at(block.E).right().length(0.6).dot().label('b', loc='right'))
    d.add(elm.Label().at((4.6, -3.2)).label('Xwrapped'))
```
